title: "UTHO! 12 BAJ GAYE!" ⏰💀 Jab Ammi Subah Pankha Band Kar Dein! (Desi Comedy Animation)
description:
Duniya ka sabse khatarnaak alarm clock mobile ka nahi hota... balkay subah 7:00 baje Ammi ka wo switch board par khamosh hamla hota hai! 🔌⚡

Idhar switch off hua, udhar 10 second ke andar lihaf ke andar ka temperature 50 degree cross kar gaya! Aur peechay se Ammi ka iconic dialogue: 'Utho! 12 baj gaye hain!'... Halankay ghari mein abhi sirf 7:15 hue hotay hain! 😂
